title: Valuation ring realizes a specialization of scheme points
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $y',y\in Y$ with $y'$ specializing to $y$. Then there exist a valuation ring $A$ (an integral domain in which every nonzero fraction-field element or its inverse lies in $A$) whose fraction field is an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure] of $\kappa(y')$ and a morphism $\rho:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ sending the closed point to $y$, such that the restriction of $\rho$ to the generic point is the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(y')}\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y')\to Y$.
